concerns.text: The plan states that the curated CSV contains **20** organic molecules (see “A bundled CSV (`data/raw/ri_curated.csv`) containing **20** organic molecules…”). This dataset size is far below the assumption in the specification that a sufficient public dataset will provide **at least 500 samples** to train a meaningful model and achieve statistical power. With only 20 records the paired statistical test will be severely under‑powered, and the model cannot be expected to generalize, violating FR‑001 and the methodological premise of the project.
